pack.title: Unit 8.0 Summarizing Virtualization and Cloud Concepts

questions.stem: A technical writer needs Windows 11 and Windows Server running at the same time on her Linux laptop, and she must keep Linux as the laptop's operating system. Which of the following BEST meets these needs?

reference.title: Hypervisors
reference.find: on top of an existing host

questions.stem: A food bank's new server will run only its donor database, email, and file server VMs and the virtualization software under them, with no host OS to pay for or patch. Which of the following should be installed on the server?
A teacher copies a lab VM's files from her school PC to her home PC. Which of the following must the home PC have before the VM will start?

An insurance company's developer wants to see how her new claims app runs on Windows 11 and on Ubuntu Linux, each limited to a small amount of memory and a single CPU core, using only her own workstation. Which of the following BEST meets this need?

reference.title: Uses for Virtualization
reference.find: Test software applications under different OSs

questions.stem: A school district wants teachers to always run the newest release of its grading program without installing it, while they keep using their laptops' own desktops. Which of the following BEST meets this need?

A county clerk's office plans to move its file, print, and web server roles off three separate physical servers and into VMs on one new server. Which of the following is the BEST reason for this change?

choices.text: Removing a single point of failure
Running legacy software on a newer OS
Making better use of the hardware
Streaming apps to staff without installing them

reference.title: Uses for Virtualization
reference.find: improved hardware utilization through server consolidation

questions.stem: A hospital is replacing the desktop PCs at its nursing stations with thin clients that log on to virtual desktops hosted in its own data center. Which of the following BEST describes the work each thin client will do?

choices.text: Showing the screen and sending keyboard and mouse input
Running the apps and storing the patient data
Hosting the desktop VM in a local hypervisor
Keeping local backups of the nurses' files

reference.title: Uses for Virtualization
reference.find: thin client only needs to display

questions.stem: A chain of veterinary clinics wants its receptionists to log on to Windows VMs that a cloud provider hosts and runs, so the clinics can retire their own servers. Which of the following BEST describes this setup?

reference.title: Uses for Virtualization
reference.find: Provisioning VDI as a cloud service

questions.stem: A theme park's web team must run four copies of its ride wait-time app on one Linux server, keeping each copy isolated from the others without giving any copy its own guest OS. Which of the following BEST meets this need?

reference.title: Uses for Virtualization
reference.find: isolating resources at the OS level

questions.stem: A technician installs a hypervisor on a new desktop whose CPU supports AMD-V, but the hypervisor warns that the CPU's virtualization support is turned off. Which of the following should the technician change to turn it on?

A trainer's Windows 11 PC has 8 GB of RAM and runs one Windows 11 VM well, but her new class needs two Windows 11 VMs running on it at once, each put back to a clean state after class. Which of the following should she do?

choices.text: Turn off SLAT to save memory
Add more memory to the PC
Take a snapshot of each VM
Run Windows 11 in a Linux container

questions.stem: An IT engineer at an electric utility will run 64-bit router, firewall, and server VMs at the same time on one PC to see how traffic flows between them before he changes the real equipment. Which of the following must the PC have?

choices.text: A 32-bit hypervisor to host the 64-bit VMs
RAM for the host OS plus each guest OS
Saved snapshots of each VM's disk
Disk space for each VM's image file
A virtual network set up by the hypervisor

reference.title: Virtualization Resource Requirements
reference.find: create a virtual network allowing communication

questions.stem: A support team keeps eight server VMs, each with several snapshots, on one PC to recreate customer setups, but the team starts only one VM at a time. Which of the following resources does this PC need MOST?

A furniture maker runs the VMs for its sales, payroll, and design departments on one host, and its IT staff worry about VM escaping, where malware in one guest OS could reach the other VMs or the host. Which of the following would BEST protect against this threat?

choices.text: Install antivirus software on the host
Keep the hypervisor patched with updates
Connect the host to a UPS
Set up high availability for the VMs

reference.title: Virtualization Security Requirements
reference.find: keep the hypervisor patched with updates

questions.stem: A video production studio's cloud provider tracks the storage, processing time, and bandwidth the studio consumes each month and bills the studio for exactly that amount. Which of the following cloud characteristics does this describe?

reference.title: Cloud Characteristics
reference.find: pay only for what they use

questions.stem: Traffic to a sneaker shop's website spikes within minutes of each new shoe release, and its cloud provider adds server capacity as traffic climbs, with no slowdown for shoppers. Which cloud characteristic BEST describes this?

A public radio station wants the extra cloud servers that handle its yearly pledge drive to shut down on their own as pledges slow, so it stops paying for them. Which cloud characteristic BEST meets this need?

reference.title: Cloud Characteristics
reference.find: reduce costs when demand is low

questions.stem: A home security company's contract with its cloud provider allows the alarm monitoring service to be down for only about five minutes a year. Which cloud characteristic does this contract term guarantee?

When the cloud server running a ride-share company's app fails, the provider moves the app to a standby server within seconds, so riders barely notice. Which cloud characteristic is this setup meant to provide?

A cloud provider runs virtual servers for a florist and many other customers on one physical host, and the provider's software gives each server part of that host's CPU and memory. Which cloud characteristic does this describe?
A roofing company hosts its website with a large cloud provider that sells the same hosting service to thousands of unrelated businesses. Which cloud deployment model is the company using?
A wedding photographer wants cloud storage for her client galleries that starts out free and moves to pay-as-you-go pricing as her business grows. Which cloud deployment model BEST fits her plan?

reference.title: Common Cloud Deployment Models
reference.find: often includes subscription or pay-as-you-go options

questions.stem: The IT division of a state's motor vehicle agency builds and runs a cloud that the agency's other divisions use, because driver records need strict access control. Which cloud deployment model BEST fits the agency?

reference.title: Common Cloud Deployment Models
reference.find: business unit typically manages the cloud

questions.stem: An accounting firm keeps clients' sensitive tax records on servers in its own office, but it sends invoices through a billing service that a cloud provider offers to any business. Which cloud deployment model is the firm using?

Three credit unions in neighboring states follow the same security policies, and they split the cost of one cloud that only the three of them can use. Which cloud deployment model are the credit unions using?

A charter school stops buying and repairing its own servers and rents virtual servers from a cloud provider instead, but its IT staff still manage everything that runs on them. Which cloud service model is the school using?

To spread shoppers across the web servers behind its new ordering site, a seafood supplier adds a load balancer and a virtual network to its cloud account. Which cloud service model does this describe?

reference.title: Common Cloud Service Models
reference.find: servers, storage, networking, and load balancers

questions.stem: A regional grocery chain's programmers upload code they wrote to a cloud service that already runs the servers, PHP, and a MySQL database. Which cloud service model is the chain using?

reference.title: Common Cloud Service Models
reference.find: This platform could be based on

questions.stem: A web design firm is reviewing a cloud provider's offer for Platform as a Service (PaaS). Which of the following BEST describes what the firm would get?

choices.text: Virtual servers, storage, and networks that the firm sets up and runs itself
Ready-made applications delivered over the Internet, with nothing to install
Servers and storage plus tools for building, testing, and deploying its own apps
Virtual desktops that its staff can reach from any device, run by the provider

questions.stem: A dental practice stops buying and installing office apps on each of its PCs and instead pays a monthly subscription per user to use the apps over the Internet. Which cloud service model is the practice now using?

Rather than have programmers build a crew-scheduling app with a cloud provider's development tools, a house-cleaning business picks a finished scheduling app that its staff sign in to online. Which cloud service model did the business choose?

Three students work on one group report from their own laptops through a cloud storage service, which shows each student's changes and comments to the others. Which cloud characteristic makes this possible?

reference.title: Cloud File Storage
reference.find: automated file syncing, allowing multiple users
